name: Cyberimpact

evidence.marketing: F02: welcome and follow-up automation; F01 calls it a marketing and SMTP service
evidence.newsletter: F02: campaigns and newsletters, plus recurring RSS and Atom sends
evidence.transactional: F02: SMTP relay for order confirmations and password resets; staff must activate it (F05)

line: Send newsletters, automated campaigns, and app email through a hosted service.

subs.math: 1,000 contacts × 4 campaigns = 4,000 emails a month. Basic costs CAD 35 a month for one-off broadcasts. Ongoing automation needs Plus or Pro.
5,000 contacts × 4 campaigns = 20,000 emails a month. Basic costs CAD 80 a month for one-off broadcasts. Ongoing automation needs Plus or Pro.
10,000 contacts × 4 campaigns = 40,000 emails a month. Basic costs CAD 135 a month for one-off broadcasts. Ongoing automation needs Plus or Pro.
50,000 contacts × 4 campaigns = 200,000 emails a month. Basic costs CAD 449 a month for one-off broadcasts. Ongoing automation needs Plus or Pro.
